title: stop ends the database proxy's relay whether or not its face is up
intention: `cairn database stop` ends the relay process its record names, whether or not the proxy's face is up in this bus; the shim reads the relay's record when no face is up and adopts a live relay rather than calling it not running.
why: Measured 2026-11-18 on akienlivingroom, twice (at 7c07ae3a4 and ddf670792): a relay outlived the face host that spawned it and `cairn database stop` answered 'database is not running' while that relay held 5432; Stop-Process was the only way to end it. With the face up, stop dropped only the in-process face and never ended the relay. A status mouth said not running over a listening relay.
traces_to: Law 7 (a status surface must not say not running over a live relay) and Law 6 (the proxy owns its relay, so its stop is the one way to end it).
how: DatabaseProxyShim gains _relay(): the face's state() when it is up, else the record at dbproxy.__main__.record_path() read the same way (a listening record whose pid is dead reads stopped). running is True when _relay() reads listening; a live relay with no face is adopted by bringing the face up (its wake is a no-op over a listening relay), so the base hot path always has a face. _stop_device ends the record's pid through _kill(pid) (os.kill with SIGTERM, which is TerminateProcess on Windows), then defers to the base to drop the face. The base resolver is unchanged.

clauses.claim: with the face down and the relay's recorded pid alive, `stop` ends that pid and says 'stopped database'
with the face up and the relay alive, `stop` ends the relay's pid and the face reads down
with the relay's recorded pid dead and the face down, `stop` says 'database is not running' and ends nothing

decisions.text: D1: dbproxy/shim.py: _relay reads the record without a face; running adopts a live relay; _stop_device ends the relay's pid through _kill.
D2: the proof swaps record_path for a scratch file and _kill for a recorder, one tooth per clause, shaped like cairn/devices/dbproxy/proofs/test_start_rewakes_a_dead_relay_under_a_live_face.py.

measured.saw: cairn database stop said 'database is not running' while an orphaned relay held 5432; with the face up, stop left the relay listening
measured.how: akienlivingroom_cc_0 read the listeners on 5432 before and after cairn database stop, at 7c07ae3a4 and at ddf670792
